The ones I grabbed are equivalent to 60w incandescent, the light emitted is very pale and sterile compared to incandescent but I don't really mind it. After having a couple table lamps on in my living room for a few hours tonight I feel like my eyes are sore and have very slight headache, I ended up switching the bulbs down to the basement and putting those incandescent in the lamps upstairs and the effects seem to be subsiding now. I can't even imagine using these in an open fixture, they are bad enough in a lamp with a shade. To my eyes the the actual LED bulb seems twice as bright to look at compared to its incandescent equivalent, even though they are both rated at 800 lumens.
